description: One JSON object per line with `level`, `time`, `msg` and fields, so log platforms can filter and aggregate.
A logger that adds fixed bindings (`requestId`, `jobId`) to every line it writes.
Replacing sensitive fields (passwords, tokens, authorization headers) before a log line leaves the process.
An id per request, reused from `X-Request-Id` or generated, returned to the client and attached to every log line.
The value below which p% of observations fall. p95 and p99 latency describe the slow requests an average hides.
The number of distinct label values of a metric. Ids or raw paths as labels explode storage and cost.
Vendor-neutral standard and SDKs for logs, metrics and traces, with auto-instrumentation for Node.js libraries.
